The best talk at DevConf was 20 minutes of build-time graphs.

The speaker, an infra lead at a mid-size fintech, showed what happened when they got CI from 22 minutes to 4: pull requests shrank by half within a quarter, because engineers stopped batching changes to avoid the wait. Nobody told them to. Review quality went up as a side effect.

Her one-liner that stuck with me: measure the pauses, not the typing. My full notes are in the thread.
